name: Cecily Goldcrest
memories: Constance Wolfholt took my daughter into House Wolfholt.
voice: greedy, ambitious lord of House Goldcrest; speaks like a proud noble
backstory: Sent her only daughter Genevieve north to wed Godwin Wolfholt, and calls it a theft, since Constance Wolfholt set the terms. Holds the debts of half the western lords and wants the Hand's chain to go with them. Swears the Wolfholt bride died of fever at Goldrock.
